controls.method: Original complete customSimhash module loaded with available bundled NumPy. Integer fingerprint/index paths executed; no text hashing/corpus/queue/pandas or original environment install.

findings: Plural get_near_dups returns exactly independent exhaustive sets for all256queries against2568bitvalues and k0..3:1024queries. All60tied IDs retained at radius0; all64onehotdistance checks pass.
Simhash permits integral values outside declared width, distance masks high bits; equality compares value without width. Confirmed synthetic public inputs, not claimed normal text-hash failure.

Pipeline add(return_similar=True) returns one accepted Simhash candidate, then check_similar_file applies Jaccard only to that pair. Other candidates are not retried after rejection in inspected flow; actual missed text match not yet reproduced.

basic find_duplicates groups existing SHA256+Size metadata, writes discarded paths, then rewrites input pickle after dropping duplicate records. It does not byte-confirm source files or verify metadata freshness. No pandas/pickle/file operations executed.
Worker completion flag set only at producer end; producer exceptions can bypass it and worker catch-all may continue. Process lifecycle and queue draining not qualified.
Simhash text tokenization lowercases, concatenates regex words and uses four-character windows. This is a text recipe, no direct image hash or byte equality replacement.
